b2add26dad0a99e62868.en: The Disease Control Agency (hereinafter referred to as CDC) announced on October 1, 2026 that one new case of local dengue fever was added to Changhua County. For men in their 60s living in Changhua County, Changhua County, fever, diarrhea, general weakness, and other symptoms have appeared since the end of September. After returning home, they went to the hospital again because the symptoms did not improve. After reporting and testing, they were diagnosed with dengue fever, and the first type of dengue virus was detected. The case is currently hospitalized, and there are no suspected symptoms in close contacts. The CDC explained that the main place of activity during the incubation period of the case is the residence of Changhua County and the workplace of the county and city outside Changhua County. There is no history of foreign travel. After the investigation, the residence of the case is about 110 meters away from the residence of the first local type of dengue fever case in Changhua County announced by the CDC on September 18. It is preliminarily judged as a community cluster event. It is the first local dengue fever cluster in Changhua County since 2023 and will be further sequenced.

fdbea54aa9db5a9d6c88.en: Representative Lee Xi-hyung (STAY-G) received the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism's citation at the ‘53rd Tourism Day’ ceremony held on the 30th of last month. Lee was recommended for the field of camping. Lee has promoted a project that applies the experience of hotel management to the operation of campgrounds. Stage is working with the Korean Campground Association to introduce a sales channel management system (CMS) and a facility operation management system (PMS) for campsites. The system links reservation, sales, customer and facility management. We plan to reduce the operational burden of the campsite by systematizing on-site tasks such as customer service and cleanliness and safety management.

bd97096ffacef5f48637.en: [Seoul = News] Park Mi-sun = Chinese technology company Tencent has signed a $7 billion data center lease agreement with US cloud services provider Oracle. The Financial Times (FT) reported that Tencent signed a five-year contract to lease several data centers operated by Oracle in Southeast Asia this year, citing officials familiar with the matter. It is the largest overseas data center lease agreement signed by Tencent. Officials said the agreement will allow Tencent to acquire about 100,000 advanced AI semiconductors that cannot be secured in China.

02bfd1c6e00a4bcf2fd4.en: [Cheongju = Newsis] Yeon Hyun-cheol reporter = Fighting A Malaysian who killed a foreigner of the same nationality with a weapon has been sentenced to a heavy sentence. Cheongju Law Chungju Support Criminal Division 1 (Deputy Chief Judge Bin Tae-wook) sentenced A (40-year-old), a Malaysian national, to 12 years in prison for murder and joint assault on the first day. Mr B (in his 20s) of the same nationality, who was accused of participating in the assault, was sentenced to eight months in prison. According to the court, Mr. A had a fight with Mr. C (20s) of the same nationality on the road in Daeso-eup, Eumseong-gun at 1:50 am on July 26.

0fddb8f098f2a174118e.en: [Seoul = News] Reporter Kim Ye-jin = 'Over-tourism' has emerged as a challenge due to the increase in tourists in Japan, and Kyoto City's World Heritage Site Nijo Castle has decided to introduce a 'dual-price system‘. According to the Yomiuri and Nihongeizai Shimbun (Nikkei), the mayor of Matsui Koji in Kyoto City, who manages Nijo Castle, announced at the city council that he will introduce a dual-price system in the entrance fee to Nijo Castle. He said he plans to submit an amendment to the ordinance to the city council within the year and implement it from next year. According to the Jeonju Law, Nanny, a representative of Altron charged with violating the Labor Standards Act and violating the Worker's Retirement Benefits Guarantee Act, filed an appeal in the court on the 29th of last month on the decision of the appeals court, which sentenced her to two and six months in prison. 0b5049ee28539230518b.en: Newtalk News Japanese media "Sankei Shimbun" reported that the US-China Economic and Security Review Commission (USCC) under the US Congress recently released an investigation report, pointing out that China continues to support Iran in "various aspects" such as economy, diplomacy and security, and engages in hostile activities against the United States in the US-Iran military conflict. The report puts forward a total of 64 cases, including about 400 Chinese-made man-portable air defense missiles (MANPADS) secretly sold to Iran through Hong Kong companies, and a US F-15 fighter jet shot down by a Chinese-made shoulder-fired missile in southwestern Iran. Randall Schriver, chairman of the committee, said in a statement that China's support for Iran in the US-Iran conflict "ranges from economic, diplomatic and security aspects" and "actually continues to engage in hostile activities against the United States". Report titled "Supporting Iran: Epic Wrath"
